name: fortrip
description: Search hotels worldwide, compare live room rates, book and pay securely (by payment link, or a Link wallet token where the assistant supports it), and cancel bookings with Fortrip.

interface.longDescription:
Fortrip lets you search hotels by place, name, brand or map point, read a hotel's address, policies, amenities and rooms, compare live offers and cancellation terms, book and pay securely, and cancel bookings.

Search results show indicative nightly prices; live offers come from get_hotel_offers. Offer prices are in USD, with an approximate amount in CNY on request. Before giving you a payment link or paying, the assistant shows the amount and currency you will be charged (USD), the meals, cancellation rules and any fees paid at the hotel, and waits for you to confirm. The link opens a Fortrip page that recaps the order and continues to Stripe Checkout, which may also show the amount in your local currency. An assistant that can request a token from your Link wallet (US and Canadian accounts, orders up to $500) can instead pay with a single-use token you approve in the wallet; the payment is held until the hotel confirms. The assistant refuses card numbers, and nothing is charged without your approval on the Stripe page or in your wallet.

Requires signing in with a Fortrip account. Stays are 1 to 15 nights, with 1 to 8 rooms per order. Adults and children are counted per room, and every room in an order has the same party. Guest names must use Latin letters as on the passport. You can check an order's status and list your orders, including those made on the Fortrip website. You can cancel a confirmed order under its cancellation terms: the assistant first shows the penalty and the refund and waits for you to confirm, and you are never charged more than the penalty you agreed to. Flights, activities and changes to existing orders are not supported.
capabilities: Book and pay by secure link
Pay with a Link wallet token
defaultPrompt: Find 5-star hotels in Bangkok near the river for 2 adults, 2 nights next month.
Compare live offers with free cancellation at three Shanghai hotels near the Bund.
Plan a split stay in Tokyo and Kyoto on a budget of 200 USD per night.

positive.description: Search hotels in a city for given dates
positive.prompt: Find 5-star hotels in Bangkok for 2 adults, checking in 30 days from today for 2 nights, with prices in USD.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with a place_name destination for Bangkok in Thailand, the requested dates and party, filters.stars with a minimum of 5 and displayCurrency USD, and lists matching 5-star Bangkok hotels with their indicative price per room per night in USD, saying these are indicative prices and live offers still need to be checked.

positive.prompt: I'm staying at Anantara Riverside Bangkok Resort for 2 nights, checking in 30 days from today. What are its check-in and check-out times, address and facilities?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the hotel with search_hotels for those dates, then calls get_hotel and reports its address, check-in and check-out times and facilities from the catalogue. It doesn't present a search price as a live rate or say that a room is available.

positive.description: Compare live rates and cancellation terms
positive.prompt: Show live offers with free cancellation at Anantara Riverside Bangkok Resort for 2 adults in 1 room, 2 nights starting 45 days from today, with the amounts in CNY too.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the hotel with search_hotels, calls get_hotel_offers for it with the dates, 1 room of 2 adults, filters.requireFreeCancellation and displayCurrency CNY, and lists offers with their room, meals, free-cancellation deadline and price.total in USD, with the approximate CNY amount marked as an estimate, not the charge. If the hotel has no free-cancellation offer for those dates, it says so.

positive.description: Compare two check-in dates within a budget
positive.prompt: I need 3 nights in Shanghai for 2 adults in 1 room, checking in either 30 or 37 days from today, for under 150 USD per night. Which dates and hotels give the best value?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels for Shanghai for each check-in date with filters.price.maxPerRoomNight of 150 USD, then get_hotel_offers for a shortlist of the results on each date; it may also call get_planning_guide first. It compares each offer's price.total per night (price.total divided by 3 nights, for 1 room) with the 150 USD budget and recommends options within it, each with its dates, price.total in USD, meals and cancellation terms. It treats search prices as indicative and calls a hotel available only when get_hotel_offers returned an offer for it.

positive.description: Create a booking payment link after confirmation
positive.prompt: Book the cheapest free-cancellation room at Anantara Riverside Bangkok Resort for 1 adult in 1 room, 2 nights starting 60 days from today. Guest: John Smith, email john.smith@example.com, phone +1 415 555 0100.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the hotel, calls get_hotel_offers with filters.requireFreeCancellation, and calls book_hotel with the cheapest free-cancellation offer, the guest in room 1 and the contact's name, email and phone. It shows the stay, the price.total with its currency, the meals, cancellation rules, confirmation mode and pay-at-hotel fees, and asks the user to confirm. Only after the user confirms does it give the payment.url link, a https://fortrip.ai/booking-status page that recaps the order and continues to Stripe Checkout. Nothing is charged unless the user pays there. If no free-cancellation offer is available, it says so and asks how to proceed instead of ordering another offer.

negative.description: Flights are out of scope: Fortrip only searches and books hotels.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Shanghai to Bangkok next Friday.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Fortrip tool. Says that Fortrip can't search or book flights.

negative.description: Saving a payment card isn't supported: the plugin never handles card details, and each booking is paid on its own, by its payment link or a single-use token the user approves in their Link wallet.
negative.prompt: Save my credit card to my Fortrip account so my next hotel booking is charged automatically.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Fortrip tool and doesn't ask for card details. Explains that it can't save a card to the Fortrip account or charge it, and that each order is paid on its own: on the Fortrip payment page its payment link opens, or with a single-use token the user approves in their Link wallet.

negative.description: The tools can't change an existing booking's dates, room or guests; Fortrip support handles that by email.
negative.prompt: Move my hotel booking in Bangkok to next week.
negative.expected_behavior: Doesn't cancel or order anything. Explains that it can't change an existing order, and tells the user to email info@fortrip.ai with the order's reference.

review.commerce_description: Users can book hotel stays. book_hotel creates an unpaid order for one offer and returns a link to a Fortrip page on fortrip.ai that recaps the order and its terms; the user completes payment there through Stripe Checkout. Alternatively, pay_order pays the order with a single-use Stripe shared payment token the user approves in their Link wallet (US and Canadian accounts, orders up to $500); the payment is held until the hotel confirms. Before giving the link or paying, the assistant shows the amount and currency charged, the meals, cancellation rules and pay-at-hotel fees, and waits for the user to confirm. The plugin refuses card numbers, and nothing is charged without the user's approval on the Stripe page or in their Link wallet.

publication.release_notes: Clearer booking, payment and cancellation: before giving you a payment link, the assistant shows the total in USD, the meals, the cancellation rules and any fees paid at the hotel; before cancelling, the penalty and the refund. Each time it waits for your confirmation. Assistants that can request a token from your Link wallet (US and Canadian accounts, orders up to $500) can also pay with a single-use token you approve.

zh-CN.subtitle: 搜索并预订酒店
zh-CN.description:
Fortrip 可以按地点、酒店名、品牌或地图上的位置搜索酒店，查看酒店地址、政策、设施和房型，比较实时报价和取消条款，安全地预订和付款，并取消预订。

搜索结果中的价格是参考起价，实时报价以 get_hotel_offers 为准。报价以美元计，可按需附上人民币的估算金额。给出付款链接或付款前，助手会先展示实际收款的金额和币种（美元）、餐食、取消规则和到店需付的费用，并等你确认。链接打开的是 Fortrip 的订单摘要页，页面汇总订单信息后进入 Stripe 付款，Stripe 付款页可能同时以你所在地的货币显示金额。能从你的 Link 钱包申请付款令牌的助手（限美国和加拿大账户，订单不超过 500 美元）也可以改用你在钱包里批准的一次性令牌付款，款项会先冻结，酒店确认后才扣款。助手不接受银行卡号；未经你在 Stripe 付款页或钱包里批准，不会扣费。

需要登录 Fortrip 账号。每次入住 1 到 15 晚，每单 1 到 8 间房。成人和儿童人数按每间房计算，同一订单的每间房入住人数相同。入住人姓名需使用与护照一致的拉丁字母。可以查询订单状态和订单列表，包括在 Fortrip 网站下的订单。已确认的订单可以按取消条款取消：助手会先展示违约金和退款金额并等你确认，实际收取的违约金不会超过你同意的金额。不支持机票、活动，也不支持修改已有订单。
